newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS confirms Talisman debt ratings.
newsitem.headline: DBRS confirms Talisman debt ratings.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service Ltd said on Wednesday it confirmed its A rating for Talisman Energy Inc's unsecured debentures and medium term notes and R-1 (low) rating for the commercial paper, both with a stable trend.
DBRS said Talisman had increased and diversified its reserves, production and cash flow as a result of property and corporate acquisitions and internally generated finding and development success.

Talisman's debt levels represent about 30 percent of capitalization, or 1.5 times cash flow, which is relatively conservative, DBRS said. "However, profitability is not overly impressive," it said. (( Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
